headline: Yanming (Owen) Dong climbs to 27th on ARC-2

sections.text: Yanming (Owen) Dong gained 10.00 points to reach 51.25, moving from 44th to 27th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The 16th-place gold cutoff is 63.06, 2.09 points above Dong’s score.
